standard._min_pct_above_52w_low: price at least 30% above the 52-week low (your 'true 30%'; in TradingView: 'Price above Low 52W by 30% or more')

DAILY TIGHTNESS._min_tight_days: today is a tight day and at least 3 of the last 5 days (today included) were tight (low volume + narrow range); set within_last_days to 3 for 3 in a row
DAILY TIGHTNESS._range_vs_avg10_max: today's high-low range at most 0.8 x the average range of the previous 10 days (same as MSF 'Tight day: range <= X x 10-day avg range'); 0 = off

lists._setups_higher_high_low: off (your choice, Oct 25) · strict = the last two swing highs and lows are rising · structure = stays on until price breaks the last higher low
lists._no_chase_1y_pct: off (your choice, Oct 25); a number (e.g. 300) skips stocks up that much in 12 months
